text:
elaine: taking over the evening window, i'm primary for the next 8h. heads-up: latency p95 on text-gen has been noisy for the past hour. i've left notes in the handoff doc.

ajay: thanks. are you seeing correlation with the kvcache thrash alerts?

elaine: yes, kvcache eviction count spiked on region-eu-02 around 20:10. likely hit by a burst of seq-length 8192 requests.

sam: incident-bot created INC-5567 for the latency spike :rotating_light: pager duty called primary once.

incident-bot: INCIDENT INC-5567 created by monitoring@rt. Severity: P2. Affected services: inference-runtime, kvcache-service. Links: https://redwood.internal/incidents/INC-5567, https://grafana.redwood/r/abc123/latency-dashboard

elaine: quick plan: 1) reduce batching on region-eu-02 to force lower memory usage 2) flush problematic keys for hotspot models 3) scale up kvcache-backend by 1 replica if needed 4) if latency persists, rollback latest runtime patch (rev b4f2).

maria: copying runbooks here: kv-cache-thrashing runbook https://runbooks.redwood/kvcache-thrashing and runtime-rollbacks https://runbooks.redwood/runtime-rollback. they're short. follow order: mitigations -> scale -> rollback.

ajay: if someone needs commands, here's the safe playback:
```bash
# reduce batch size for model-prod-7b on eu-02
redwoodctl config set --cluster eu-02 --route text-gen --key batching.max_tokens=512
# scale kvcache backend
redwoodctl scale set --service kvcache-backend --cluster eu-02 --replicas +1
# flush suspected hotspot prefix (careful, scoped)
redis-cli -h cache-eu-02 --scan --pattern 'model:prod7b:hot:*' | xargs -L 100 redis-cli -h cache-eu-02 del
```

sam: note: the flush above is destructive if used broadly. prefer scoped delete and watch miss-rate. also watch token billing impacts when batch size changes.

elaine: marking who does what: ajay, you take immediate scale + batch tweak. sam, you do safe-scan for hotspot prefixes and coordinate deletion with maria. i'll monitor customer impact and keep the PD loop open.

ajay: on it. running batch tweak now — will post result.

(5m) ajay: batch tweak applied on eu-02: batching.max_tokens -> 512. Observing tail latency in logs, will give it 3 minutes.

(9m) sam: did a non-destructive scan, there are ~120 keys with hot prefixes. starting dry-run delete of top 10 keys and watching miss rate.

incident-bot: Pager escalated to secondary after 12 minutes (auto-escalation). secondary @maria alerted.

maria: i'm available for the next 4h. if rollback needed i can run the orchestrated runtime rollback (see runbook). otherwise i'll prep traffic-split to fallback smaller model.

elaine: customer-impact quick note: a subset of requests to the hosted API show 200ms+ p95 regression for EU customers, no 5xx spike yet. sending short notice to support.

ajay: after batch change p95 dropped by ~30% in first window. no 5xx. keeping an eye on token consumption.

sam: dry-run delete of top keys complete. miss-rate rose 0.7% (expected). latency for the sample route improved.

elaine: tie-breaker: if we see any 5xxs or p95 doesn't go under 400ms in 10m, we escalate to rollback. maria, prep rollback bundle and I’ll thumbs-up.

maria: prep done: rollback bundle rev b4f2 ready. steps in runbook: 
1) schedule short maintenance window in routing (30s)
2) pin model pool to rev b4f2
3) verify KV cache warmup via synthetic requests
4) lift maintenance.

elaine: adding quick links for oncall cheat-sheet:
- runbooks dashboard: https://runbooks.redwood/
- common mitigation snippets: https://runbooks.redwood/snippets/oncall-cheats
- incident channel template: #inc-templates

ajay: small note — if scaling doesn't help, consider temporary routing to dedicated capacity (reds-dedicated-eu) for heavy customers. that's a last-resort as cost hits.

sam: logged actions in INC-5567 timeline. current status: mitigations in progress, monitoring.

(35m) ajay: scaling completed +1 replica, observed memory headroom increase, p95 trending down. leaving autoscaler as-is.

maria: rollback remains on standby. i'll only execute on explicit approval.

elaine: wrapping handoff notes for the next night primary: i'll leave a short checklist in the shift doc. please call me if it flares. thanks team. :thumbsup:

sam: thanks, all. documented next steps and housekeeping in the incident ticket.

incident-bot: INCIDENT INC-5567 updated. Current severity: P2. Status: Mitigating. Timeline link: https://redwood.internal/incidents/INC-5567/timeline
